set_aside.subject: project-create conflict with an ineligible named customer
set_aside.text: “one with other facts refuses the create as a conflict, a refusal of stage (6) ... Otherwise (6) a named customer that the same answer called erased, restricted or ended refuses it” conflicts with “Every refusal names every failure of its stage”
set_aside.question: When a project create has both a conflicting request id and an erased, restricted or ended named customer, must the stage (6) refusal name both failures, or only the request-id conflict?
options: Name both the request-id conflict and the customer-eligibility failure
Name only the request-id conflict because the customer check is under “Otherwise”

witness.initial: An existing project carries request id K; Customer C exists and is restricted.
events: The owner submits create-project with request id K, facts different from the existing project's current facts, and customer_ref C.
module:projects receives the earlier eligibility answer that C is restricted, then finds K on the existing project with different facts.
outcomes: The refusal names only the request-id conflict, following the “Otherwise” branch structure.
The refusal names both the request-id conflict and the restricted customer, following the rule that every failure of the first failing stage is named.
witness.observer: The owner sees different refusal details in the owner interface.
